fields.Name: T089 - Entity Form Expand All and Collapse All Sections
fields.Description: Exercises the bulk expand-all/collapse-all toolbar controls (OnExpandAll/OnCollapseAll with disabled-state logic driven by ExpandedSectionCount) — a distinct feature from single-section navigation and from the section-search filter.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Members' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box, click a member row, then 'Open Full Record'. In the form toolbar (right side) there are two icon buttons: 'Collapse all sections' (chevrons pointing up) and 'Expand all sections' (chevrons pointing down). Click 'Collapse all sections' and confirm the form sections collapse to their headers; then click 'Expand all sections' and confirm the section bodies re-open. Success is the sections RESPONDING to both bulk toggles. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'Collapse all sections' collapses the form's section panels to their headers
Clicking 'Expand all sections' re-expands the section bodies
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
